title: A source with no home at /
why: Every page lives under a locale prefix and `/` is a 404. This cannot be a trait of the shared fixture, because a server that answers `/` is not this source — which is the whole argument for a corpus over a bigger fixture. A replica's home page is `post:<site>/`, the one form the address grammar does not spell, so a source that has nothing to put there is the case that decides what the replica serves at its own root.
